artworks.title: Exedra of the Epigoni
artworks.description: The Exedra of the Epigoni — monumental memory of the sons who took Thebes a generation after the Seven. Amphilochus son of Amphiaraus marches in that second wave before his Argive and Amphilochian afterlife.

popCulture.title: Epigoni
popCulture.description: The sons of the Seven Against Thebes — Amphilochus among them as Amphiaraus' and Eriphyle's child in Homer and Apollodorus (some later accounts make him Alcmaeon's son instead).

popCulture.title: Amphilochus I of Argos
popCulture.description: Son of Amphiaraus — Epigonus, seer, and eponym of Amphilochian Argos; not Amphilochus son of Alcmaeon, nor the amphipod genus.

popCulture.title: Amphiaraus
popCulture.description: Amphilochus' father — the seer swallowed by the earth at Thebes whose sons avenge him with the Epigoni.
